harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up /srv/data on node1 as a btrfs subvolume (backed by a loop-mounted sparse image, persisted via /etc/fstab) so it is recoverable through filesystem snapshots. Populated baseline application data, took a read-only btrfs snapshot, then modified /srv/data (deleted a file, edited two others, added junk), and restored the exact pre-modification content by recreating the subvolume from the snapshot. Verified via SHA-256 hashes that restored content exactly matches the original baseline. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id/uptime baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified that the btrfs loop mount auto-recovered via fstab with data hashes still matching baseline.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 storage: single ext4 root partition, no LVM/btrfs by default
Confirmed btrfs-progs and lvm2 available
Created 2G sparse image /var/lib/srv-data-backing/data.img and attached as /dev/loop0
Formatted loop device as btrfs, created subvolume 'data' mounted at /srv/data
Added persistent /etc/fstab entries using loop mount option for both the top-level btrfs mount and /srv/data subvolume mount
Verified fstab-based mount works via umount/mount -a
Populated baseline app data under /srv/data (config, logs, records.txt) and recorded SHA-256 hashes
Created read-only btrfs snapshot 'data-snap-20260929-111016' of /srv/data
Modified /srv/data: edited settings.conf, deleted records.txt, added junk.txt, appended to app.log
Restored /srv/data by deleting the live subvolume and recreating it as a writable snapshot from the read-only snapshot
Verified restored file listing and SHA-256 hashes exactly match the original baseline
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline on node1
Rebooted node1 via 'systemctl reboot' launched in background so acknowledgement returned first
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset
Re-verified /srv/data mount, loop device, btrfs subvolumes, and file hashes post-reboot all match baseline/restored state

evidence.requirement: /srv/data set up to be recoverable via filesystem snapshots (btrfs subvolume on loop-backed image, persisted in fstab)
evidence.summary: Confirmed no native snapshot fs on root, provisioned loop-backed btrfs image, created 'data' subvolume mounted at /srv/data, added fstab entries and verified mount -a re-mounts correctly

evidence.requirement: Baseline application data captured and a snapshot taken before modification
evidence.summary: Populated /srv/data with app config/logs/records, recorded SHA-256 hashes, then created read-only btrfs snapshot 'data-snap-20260929-111016'

evidence.requirement: Directory modified after snapshot (edit, delete, add files)
evidence.summary: settings.conf edited, records.txt deleted, junk.txt added, app.log appended; hashes differ from baseline

evidence.requirement: Exact restore of snapshot content into /srv/data
evidence.summary: Recreated /srv/data subvolume from the read-only snapshot; post-restore file listing and SHA-256 hashes match the original baseline exactly, junk.txt gone, records.txt restored

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a, uptime since 11:09:31, confirmed /srv/data mounted and file hashes match restored baseline

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), observed connection loss during reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id 6dbf2779-82f9-4fe1-b706-a365e32675ed and fresh uptime, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of /srv/data, mount, and data integrity
evidence.summary: After reboot, loop device and both fstab mounts (top-level btrfs and /srv/data subvolume) auto-recovered, btrfs subvolume list shows snapshot and data subvolumes intact, and file hashes still match the original baseline
